# Native part of the Android keyboard: the shared engine (src/engine) plus the JNI bridge,
# built into one small shared library, libjulyengine.so.

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22.1)
project(JulyBanglaAndroid LANGUAGES CXX)

get_filename_component(JULY_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../../../.." ABSOLUTE)

set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 20)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

# --- Host tools ------------------------------------------------------------------------
# The layout and SutonnyMJ tables are generated by tools/layoutgen, which must run on the
# build machine. They are built here with the host CMake and compiler (passed in by Gradle
# as JULY_HOST_CMAKE), never with the NDK.
if(NOT JULY_HOST_CMAKE)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "JULY_HOST_CMAKE is not set (Gradle passes it; see android/README.md).")
endif()

set(host_dir "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/host-tools")
execute_process(
    COMMAND "${JULY_HOST_CMAKE}" -S "${JULY_ROOT}/tools/layoutgen" -B "${host_dir}"
            -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release --no-warn-unused-cli
    RESULT_VARIABLE host_result)
if(NOT host_result EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Configuring the host tools failed (${host_result}).")
endif()
execute_process(
    COMMAND "${JULY_HOST_CMAKE}" --build "${host_dir}" --config Release
    RESULT_VARIABLE host_result)
if(NOT host_result EQUAL 0)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "Building the host tools failed (${host_result}).")
endif()
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS
    "${JULY_ROOT}/tools/layoutgen/CMakeLists.txt"
    "${JULY_ROOT}/tools/layoutgen/LayoutGen.cpp"
    "${JULY_ROOT}/tools/layoutgen/ClassicGen.cpp")

set(host_suffix "")
if(CMAKE_HOST_WIN32)
    set(host_suffix ".exe")
endif()
set(JULY_LAYOUTGEN "${host_dir}/bin/july_layoutgen${host_suffix}")
set(JULY_CLASSICGEN "${host_dir}/bin/july_classicgen${host_suffix}")

# --- Generated tables (always strict: every row verified) -------------------------------
set(gen_dir "${CMAKE_BINARY_DIR}/generated")
set(bijoy_inc "${gen_dir}/july/engine/generated/BijoyLayout.inc")
set(classic_inc "${gen_dir}/july/engine/generated/ClassicTable.inc")

add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${bijoy_inc}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${gen_dir}/july/engine/generated"
    COMMAND "${JULY_LAYOUTGEN}" "${JULY_ROOT}/layouts/bijoy.layout" "${bijoy_inc}" --strict
    DEPENDS "${JULY_ROOT}/layouts/bijoy.layout" "${JULY_LAYOUTGEN}"
    COMMENT "Generating Bijoy layout table"
    VERBATIM)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${classic_inc}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${gen_dir}/july/engine/generated"
    COMMAND "${JULY_CLASSICGEN}" "${JULY_ROOT}/layouts/sutonnymj.classic" "${classic_inc}" --strict
    DEPENDS "${JULY_ROOT}/layouts/sutonnymj.classic" "${JULY_CLASSICGEN}"
    COMMENT "Generating SutonnyMJ classic table"
    VERBATIM)

# --- libjulyengine.so -------------------------------------------------------------------
file(GLOB engine_sources CONFIGURE_DEPENDS "${JULY_ROOT}/src/engine/src/*.cpp")

add_library(julyengine SHARED JulyJni.cpp ${engine_sources} "${bijoy_inc}" "${classic_inc}")

target_include_directories(julyengine PRIVATE "${JULY_ROOT}/src/engine/include" "${gen_dir}")

# Small and hardened: no exceptions/RTTI (the engine uses neither), hidden symbols except
# the JNI entry points, unused code removed, size-optimised in release.
target_compile_options(julyengine PRIVATE
    -Wall -Wextra -Werror
    -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti -fvisibility=hidden -fvisibility-inlines-hidden
    -ffunction-sections -fdata-sections -fstack-protector-strong
    $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:-Os -flto=thin>)
target_link_options(julyengine PRIVATE
    -Wl,--gc-sections -Wl,--exclude-libs,ALL -Wl,-z,relro,-z,now
    $<$<NOT:$<CONFIG:Debug>>:-flto=thin -Wl,--icf=all>)
target_link_libraries(julyengine PRIVATE log)
